seen.extent: One letter, Rivals (French minister at Cassel) to Sieyès at Berlin, 19 vendémiaire an VII / 10 Oct 1798, numbered n° 1, in Dossier 10 (Correspondance avec Cassel) of 284AP/12; length and share in cipher not stated
seen.cipher: The inventory entry reads: "19 vendémiaire an VII / 10 octobre 1798 (partiellement chiffrée, le déchiffrement manque), n° 1." It is the only item of the carton whose decipherment the inventory says is missing; the other Rivals letters marked "chiffrée" (30 Dec 1798, 20 Jan, 13 Feb, 21 Mar 1799) carry no such remark. The leaf itself has not been seen, and the cipher system is not known.

prior_art.tomokiyo: The repo copy of Tomokiyo's unsolved list (unsolved.htm) has no line with Sieyès, Rivals, Rastatt or the Directory-period Cassel legation; a web search on Rivals, Cassel and Sieyès returned no cryptiana page.
prior_art.lasry: No Lasry paper on Directory-period French legation ciphers came up in the three web searches run for this letter; nothing on Rivals or the Sieyès papers.
prior_art.edition: Montarlot and Pingaud, Le Congrès de Rastatt (1912-13), the edition the inventory cites for Dossier 8, opened in full text on archive.org (lecongrsderast01/02/03montuoft): no occurrence of Rivals in any of the three volumes. Bailleu, Preussen und Frankreich von 1795 bis 1807, vol. 1 (archive.org preussenundfran01bailgoog) opened: Rivals occurs three times, all about Talleyrand's instruction to him of 26 Sept 1798; his letter to Sieyès of 10 Oct 1798 is not printed. Marquant, Les archives Sieyès (1970) is the inventory quoted here. Fauré's Des manuscrits de Sieyès edits Sieyès's own writings and was not opened.
prior_art.literature: Web searches on Rivals at Cassel, the Sieyès Berlin mission and 284 AP found the Bailleu volume and catalogue records of the Marquant inventory, no study or decipherment of the Rivals letter. Brice Dudout's note in issue #382 (in the lead's status, not checked by the project) also leaves this letter as the unread piece.
